text:
anya: Quick report from a customer onboarding call: they saw duplicated POSTs after token refresh + 429. Repro steps concise in staging.
rob: Which SDK/version?
anya: Node 1.4.2 and Go 0.9.1. Node retried immediately after refresh; Go delayed but rewound the body and sent twice.
sophie: Core issue = replaying mutating requests across an auth refresh unless there's an idempotency-key. We should make that explicit parity behavior.
rob: Proposed short list:
  1) Default: do NOT auto-replay non-idempotent requests across token refresh unless Idempotency-Key present.
  2) Default 429 policy: base=50ms, multiplier=2, cap=2000ms, full jitter. Honor Retry-After header if present (cap at 5s).
  3) Add opt-in `enable_safe_replay` config (false default) and document semantics.
sophie: Also add a sample-app snippet that shows: a) adding idempotency-key middleware, b) token-refresh hook that pauses mutating calls during refresh.
anya: Small logs: ```
client: POST /orders -> 401 -> refresh -> retry -> 429 -> SDK retry -> duplicate order created
```
ci-bot: New lint job `dx-idemp-check` queued for sample-app. Rules: POST to /orders or /webhook must include Idempotency-Key or an explicit comment opt-out.
deploy-bot: Alert rule added: duplicate-side-effect-rate > 0.25% -> ticket #1310.
rob: I'll draft the short RFC for SDK parity (Node/Python/Go) and include test vectors. Sophie, can you add the sample-app PR?
sophie: Yep, will add sample-app patch + CI lint. Keep the RFC <1 page.
anya: Thanks all — this should make onboarding less rocky for new customers. :thumbsup:
